method: Passive GPIO23 MCPWM hardware capture, separate rising/falling channels
conclusion: No malformed pulse widths or extra pulse/frame jitter observed in these windows. Movement steps are consistent with commanded positions; control trajectory/cadence is not ruled out as a contributor to audible movement noise.
limits: LEDC and capture share APB; common-mode clock drift is not independently measured
Digital ESP32-pad timing does not measure signal amplitude/noise at servo connector, supply droop, current or mechanical load
Single-latch capture channels can lose events during long ISR delays; no gaps or ring drops were observed here
Two eight-second windows are not a long-duration qualification
